description: Platinum Tier Vault Sync Rules - Cloud ↔ Local

cloud_to_local.description: Files/folders that Cloud pushes to Local

local_to_cloud.description: Files/folders that Local pushes to Cloud (audit trail)

local_only.description: Files/folders that NEVER sync to Cloud (security critical)

cloud_only.description: Files/folders that Cloud manages (Local reads via sync)

conflict_resolution.description: On conflict, Local version takes precedence (human-in-the-loop principle)

claim_by_move.rule: First agent to move file from Needs_Action to In_Progress/<agent>/ owns it

approval_expiry.description: Files in Pending_Approval older than 48 hours are auto-rejected
